title: Occupational health examinations
description: We conduct tests for a wide range of professionals requiring special psychophysical fitness:

items: Statutory examinations: We carry out a full range of examinations: initial, periodic, follow-up, targeted.
Specialist certification: Examinations for health and epidemiological purposes and for people working with exposure to ionising radiation.
Firearms licences: Professional examinations for individuals holding or applying for a firearms licence.
Individual arrangements: We carry out other examinations as agreed with the employer.

blocks.text: We conduct tests for a wide range of professionals requiring special psychophysical fitness:

items: Drivers and instructors: Examinations for drivers of all driving licence categories, drivers referred by the traffic control authority, driving instructors and examiners, and candidates for driving instructors and examiners.
Machine and equipment operators: Operators of road machinery and construction equipment, battery-powered and forklift trucks, overhead cranes, hoists, and pressure equipment.
Work at height: Specialist tests for people working at heights of over 3 metres.
Job seekers: Fast psychotechnical diagnostics in recruitment processes.

blocks.text: Advanced microclimate parameter measurements and energy expenditure tests (PMV, PDD, WCI, IREQ, WBGT indicators).
Professional ergonomic assessment of workstations, including a detailed assessment of working conditions at computer workstations.
